reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Really decent college that gives you overall good skills and is taught by some very good doctors.

review_content.Placements: SNMC is honestly the second-best college after SMS. The students get selected for medical officer exams or other central government jobs like UPSC and CMS. Students also get good PG seats which are decent and depend mostly on how serious you are about your preparations. But overall the college does give good opportunities.
review_content.Infrastructure: MBBS students do get big, spacious, well-lit, well-ventilated, and air-conditioned classrooms. Large enough to seat around 300 students. The hostels are average like any other government medical college hostel. The mess food is okay. Since the college location is in the heart of the city, a large number of PGs are available to take for rent as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The worst hostel, no college life.

review_content.Placements: There is no such thing as placement in our field. We have to get a four-year MBBS degree and then clear the NEET PG entrance exams for a postgraduate course. The NEET PG is very tough because we have to clear the entire subjects of all four years.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college buildings are very old and in need of repair, but there is one new building that is well maintained and air conditioned. The reading room and library are also very well maintained and provide a great environment for studying.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Great infrastructure and various fests organizing college.

review_content.Placements: Great opportunities for all students who want to become doctors and give service to society. Their are excellent results in the NEET PG course and very great teachers. Many students from our college are in India and all over the world, giving their best in the medical field.
review_content.Infrastructure: The best thing is campus; their is a cricket ground, basketball court, auditorium, and library. There is a beautiful swimming pool in college at the national level. All programs happen in an auditorium with a crowd capacity of 1200. So the infrastructure is great.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Dr. S.N Medical College, Jodhpur.

review_content.Placements: I am currently in my second year of MBBS. There are no campus placements for our class. After graduation, you have to take a PG. There is a very high probability of getting a job in government as well. They give good packages like the highest 45 INR thousand per month and after 4.5 years students have to do one year of internship.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are average, but it has a very good new academic block. The girls' hostel is also quite old and not very good. But after we came here, new rooms were also given to us in the second year. So it's kind of average in terms of infrastructure.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Review of S. N Medical College Jodhpur.

review_content.Placements: There is a one-year compulsory internship in all four attached hospitals of the college, in which every student gets an INR 20,000 per month stipend. An internship has to be done in all the departments for a specific time period. In an internship, clinical exposure is provided on how to treat and diagnose the patient. All the students got 100% jobs in government hospitals. Some of the students are going to further their studies.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are multiple grounds for football, basketball, volleyball, kabaddi, kho-kho, and cricket, and this college also has a sports club and sports secretary in the student union. This college has a poetry club and a literacy club. There is a library at my college that is well maintained and has lots of books and journals. It's infrastructure is old.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Explore Dr. S. N. Medical College Jodhpur.

review_content.Placements: It is one of the oldest medical college in india and has a prestigious name of the college. Passed out doctors get sure 100% job in any government or private hospital. Clinical cases are of great diversity to increase your knowledge. More than half of the students clear NEET PG for admission in MD and PG.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus of our college is large enough and annually a fest named as a spandan is organized by the student union and by the student contribution. Hostel facility in the college is good with neat and clean rooms. Hostel registration done at the time of admission. Infrastructure of the college is also better.

reviews.review_heading: Really decent college that gives you overall good skills and is taught by some very good doctors.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. S.N Medical College, Jodhpur.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are average, but it has a very good new academic block. The girls' hostel is also quite old and not very good. reviews.review_text: There are multiple grounds for football, basketball, volleyball, kabaddi, kho-kho, and cricket, and this college also has a sports club and sports secretary in the student union. reviews.review_heading: Explore  Dr. S. N. Medical College Jodhpur.

reviews.review_text:

Every sport is played at our college. Many times our college team has won the state-level championship, and many times they have won events in the AIIMS Delhi pulse programme. There is no drinking water, light, or garbage disposal in the hostel.

reviews.review_text:
There are almost 15 lecture theaters.
One library, one reading room, football ground, cricket ground, and for any other sports we can play, college has a separate space.
There are several messes for girls and boys.
Separate hostels are there for boys and girls.
Food is normal, but not like home-made food.

reviews.review_heading: Review on my medical college, sharing my experience, hope it will help you and guide you .
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well furnished and air conditioned. Lectures are project based. Well furnished library and reading room is available for self study and for group studies. Hostel is available for both girls and boys. It has light and water facilities, food is average and rooms are also average, both single and double rooms are available. Western and Indian toilet facilities, was...

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the top medical colleges in Rajasthan.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The library is also very good. Air-conditioners are available. There is no Wi-Fi facility. Biochemistry laboratory and physiology laboratory are available. Dissection hall for anatomy, pathology pharmacology microbiology forensic, PSM, etc., are also available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. S.N Medical College, Jodhpur.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. There is no Wi-Fi facility. Our classrooms are spacious, and around 400-500 students can accommodate easily. Lecture theatres are well furnished. Library is available and several books are provided. It also provides a reading room. Hostel rooms are small and not clean. The food served in the mess is not good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very nice. Classes have AC and are well-lightened. Teachers teach us by projectors and overall college is very nice. Hostels are also well hygienic and good rooms are provided to the students. In one room 2 students reside. Food in mess is hygienic and it's like our home.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for UG and PG.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good hostel campus and a good environment for study. Overall, good hygiene and maintenance are maintained on campus. The food served in hostels is average. reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied because of its faculty members, infrastructure, facilities, etc.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are not good in this college. reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average. The college building is quite old, but most rooms have air-conditioners, so there is no problem in the harsh summer of Jodhpur. Washrooms and toilets are not clean and sanitised, so they need to be worked on daily by the sweepers.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus with nice surroundings and staff, if you utilise time in learning .
reviews.review_text: Hostel maintenance is neat and the food is also good. There is a big library with all the good stuff that is needed for every course is provided. We can take any book that we want and have to submit it within one week. The labs are there for anatomy after classes region-wise they show body parts of human muscles and bones.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent education provided to students. 100% placement.
reviews.review_text: We have in campus Wi-Fi, hygenic restroom facilities. There are chemistry labs, anatomy and physiology lab. In the hostel, we have air-conditioned rooms with a very good environment. High quality food is served. There is a playground and medical facility also.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college but fee is high.
reviews.review_text: College had big classroom with board and projector, but fan did not work sometime. Lab was fine with basic things. Library was good with many books. Hostel was okay, and 2 sharing room. Mess food was average, not tasty. Canteen was small. Wi-Fi was slow. Medical and sports facilities were available.

reviews.review_heading: Basically, it's a very big university, but it takes a few years to build more infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There are two campuses, and increasing the infrastructure is a very nice, looking place for medical and non-medical students. There are very big hostels, like deluxe rooms and normal ones. There is Wi-Fi everywhere with a very high speed, and there are digital boards, projectors, etc., for teaching and labs. There is also a mess and cafeteria for all types of food. There are libraries and playgrounds.

reviews.review_heading: It does excellent work.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is good with durability. Classrooms for our course are amazing here. The food and hostel are of nice quality. People who stay here will have good security and can have good care. The library is available for study peacefully.

reviews.review_heading: Good and excellent work .
reviews.review_text: They have furnished hostels for staying, and labs are offered for the practice of skills. And a library for studying and computers for projects. In the hostel, they have nice food and cleaning, and they provide outing facilities to go when we need security.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, well-qualified faculty and decent placements.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the college because of its teaching, infrastructure, etc.

reviews.review_heading: This is very good college for future generation.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just amazing, as the university is newly opened. It has a good high technological infrastructure with good ventilation, smart boards, and a spacious playground for sports, celebrations, and extracurricular activities with good greenery nature.

reviews.review_heading: I am somewhat satisfied with our campus even though the university did not meet our requirements.

Hostels are not good enough to stay over as there are a lot of problems. It does not provide hot water. There is no clean maintenance, poor Wi-Fi connection, etc. Mess food is also not good sometimes. The canteen is okay. There are even medical facilities, sports, and games. Playgrounds are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The Apollo University: A place for knowledge.

Unlike other universities where they just provide a manual and ask us to do it on our own. At Apollo University, they guide us in every simple and single step.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: The Apollo University has good facilities and infrastructure. The college provides good quality food, education, and sports. However, mobile phones were restricted during classes. But the facilities provided in the labs and library were too notch.

reviews.review_heading: All we need to know about Apollo.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are good with individual seating arrangements. They have projectors, whiteboards, and speaker facilities. Air conditioners are not there in classrooms. The hostel food is better in comparison to other colleges that I have been to. They have both North Indian and South Indian canteens. A wide range of food is served here. Rooms are great. There are 3 options for accommodation which include an old hostel, a Deluxe Hostel, and an out-campus hostel. Except for the out-campus hostel, a...

reviews.review_heading: A genuine review of our college.
reviews.review_text: When it comes to infrastructure, you better don't expect more from a startup university. They were planning to grow hit as large as possible in the upcoming year. The quality of food is actually poor in this college. They will provide 2 hours exclusively for sports per once in a week.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good and practical learning is very good.
reviews.review_text: The classes are good and we have lecture halls air conditioned for big lectures and the classroom provided separately for each course is good. We have a huge library with various streams of information. We even have lab facilities provided. And about hostel it's quite good but the price is really high, food is good, the hostel rooms are available 3 and 4 sharing, with attached bathroom and balcony or without, with and without a/c . We even have separate gyms for boys and girls. We have a huge fo...

reviews.review_heading: Reasons to choose Apollo University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very large. The college property is extensive, and the campus is well-maintained, clean, and tidy. There are facilities like a library, study room, lab, canteen, common hall, etc., which anyone can use. We also have free Wi-Fi. The classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated, and the hostel and mess facilities feel very homely. The hostel rooms are spacious, and we can choose between AC and non-AC accommodations, as well as between types of sharing from 2-4 p...

reviews.review_heading: Amazing faculty, great coursework.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good and is still getting better with each passing day. The food provided in the mess is also good. We have a clinic on campus for medical facilities. The students play sports like cricket, basketball, and football every evening with great enthusiasm.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend this college for students who want to learn skills and gain great knowledge.
reviews.review_text: It has the best facilities like a library, common halls, reading rooms, various club activities, great classrooms, labs, an auditorium, and lifts. The hostels are clean and neat, though the cost is expensive, and the food is good. You can participate in competitions at the university, and there are many other facilities like transport and security.

college_info.college_name: KIIT - Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences, (KIDS)

highlights.summary:
The NEET MDS 2026 application process has commenced for Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences admission to the MDS course, with Mar 30, 2026, being the last date to register. Also, the NEET MDS exam 2026 is going to be held on May 2, 2026.

A few more updates are given below:

placements.overview: Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences, is located in Bhubaneswar, Orissa. Established in 2007, it is a private institute approved by DCI. Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences provides 11 UG, PG and Doctorate courses in several specialisations. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. BDS, MDS and Ph.D. are some of the courses offered at Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences. Some of the stream in which these courses are offered include Medicine & Health Sciences. The total fee at Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences ranges between INR 3,00,000 to 2,60,00,000. Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences has a student intake of 121 for all the courses. Kalinga Institute of Dental Sciences offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Director doesn't do his job. He is not at all cooperative.

review_content.Placements: In medical colleges, placement is 100%. The highest monthly salary is above Rs. 1 lac initially, but later, one can earn unlimited income. No companies come to recruit. Every student does an internship in our college. Top roles depend on the job the student is doing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure: everything is there but not very well-renovated. The hostel is good to stay in. The mess food is not up to the mark. But the only problem is that the room's windows are only for one person; the other person can't get any access to the windows. I need additional supplements to survive. The food is dipped in oil. Vegetables are fried to a crisp.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2016
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in our state for our course.

review_content.Placements: The college doesn't provide any placements. However, we can join the other colleges of the same rank after the course. But if we look into placements provided by the college, then it is disappointing as they don't have such provision for this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. The library and classrooms are well-equipped. The campus provides everything. Gymnasium and swimming pool are excellent. Hospital is extremely functional and has great emergency handling capacities. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: An insight into KALINGA INSTITUTE OF DENTAL Science.

review_content.Placements: The BDS course doesn't offer placements like engineering, MBA and other courses. However, they provide paid rotatory internship (which is a part of the 5 year course programme). The stipend is amongst the highest offered in indian dental colleges. Also the patient flow is satisfactory.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are 9 well-equipped and fully functional departments. Others: 6 air conditioned lecture theatres, Phantom lab (preclinical conservative lab), Preclinical prosthodontics lab and an air conditioned auditorium with a seating capacity of 300 approximately. Air conditioned library is also there.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Kalinga institute of dental science is a heaven for students who want both academics and social life

review_content.Placements: Medical and dental colleges are professional colleges so there is no tension of placement. Placement is good. Your future is settled. You can work with senior doctors after completing internship. You can prepare for MS side by side. After completing BDS you can work for any hospital or open clinic. You can start preparing for MS if you want to get into teaching line and become a professor. BDS degree has many scopes. Jobs just after completing BDS will carry packages of approximately 10 to 15 thousands per month. It will increase as your experience increases.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: The campus is good. Faculty members are good. Good infrastructure. Moderate patient flow.

review_content.Placements: There is no placement as it's a dental college, and since it is a part of medical college, according to DCI, it has the internship programme for 1 year. Since it's a medical college, placements are not currently present. I do hope that the medical boards someday would put placements in medical and dental colleges.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The college has good equipment and offers a good background to deal with a patient, but lacks in providing materials required while doing work with a patient. Otherwise, the infrastructure is overall good with a moderate patient flow in the hospital.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with its faculty, superb infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: There will be a superb placement here, according to your result as it deals with the medical subjects. The salary for the internship is Rs. 10,000 per month. Also, everyone got the internship in this college itself as one has to do the internship here only and the stipend was Rs. 10,000, which is very useful and I love it a lot.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has the best infrastructure, and I loved to go to the classes. It has a Wi-Fi available for each student individually. They also have labs for each ward. It also has AC lecture theatres and an AC library. It also has sports room. The food in the canteen is also great. Also, the hostel rooms are good and are double seated. I love it.

faqs.question: Can I select the session/slot in which I can attend exam on BITS HD exam date 2025?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates appearing in the BITS HD 2025 exam will be allowed to select their preferred exam date, centre and slot through slot booking facility. The exam authority will commence the BITS HD slot booking after the conclusion of the registration process in online mode. Candidates need to enter their registration number, date of birth (DOB), and password to complete BITS HD slot booking 2025.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in BITS Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Yes, BITS Pilani Hyderabad offer direct admissions. Candidates who are first-rank holders of all the Central and State boards are admitted directly to the specialisation of their choice, irrespective of their BITSAT score. However, the aspirants have to submit the relevant documents to the institute to seek direct admission.

faqs.question: Can I join BITS Pilani Hyderabad without BITSAT?
faqs.answer: BITS Pilani Hyderabad admission is entrance-based. BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus offers four Integrated First Degree, Higher Degree, and PhD programmes. The selection criteria for some of the courses, such as BTech, BSc, M.Tech, etc., require BITSAT entrance exam scores. Birla Institute of Technology and Science Admission Test (BITSAT) is an entrance exam conducted by the Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS), Pilani, for admissions to undergraduate engineering courses (BE) at its  Pilani campus.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in BITS Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission shall first check the course-specific eligibility criteria. Eligible students can further fill out the application form for the respective course/or the required examination. BITS Hyderabad offers admission to BE/BPharm/MSc courses is based on merit inBITSAT. For ME/MPharm course admission, BITS HD exam orGATE/GPATscores are considered. Candidates qualifying for the exam are further called for counselling. Moreover, aspirants seeking admission to PhD programmes need to take the respective entrance test for admission as well.

faqs.question: Can I apply for admission at BITS Pilani Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: BITS Pilani Hyderabad admissions are open for all courses. The college offers entrance-based admission to all UG, PG, and Doctoral courses. Candidates seeking admission to BITS Pilani Hyderabad must fill out the online application form by visiting the college official website.

hostel.description: The Institute is fully residential and hostel accommodation is provided to all students. There are six hostels for boys and two hostels for girls. There are two common kitchen cum mess units for all students. The mess serves vegetarian and non-vegetarian food and the units operate under the management of 5 member student mess council. Students staying in the hostel have to necessarily take their food in the hostel messes. Every inmate of the hostel is provided with basic amenities like cot, table, chair, ceiling fan, cupboard. reviews.review_heading: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.
reviews.review_text: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.
reviews.review_text: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.
reviews.review_text: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.

reviews.review_heading: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.
reviews.review_text: BITS is a fully residential campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, various sports grounds, and campus-wide internet connectivity. The labs and classrooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: Ups and downs of BITS through some unknown insights.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility in our hostel is not good. The land cables work better than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are neat and tidy. Hostels are clean, but there is a dumping ground near, which sometimes ends with a bad odour. The mess food is better than most of the colleges, and the canteen is affordable. Sports facilities are quite good and almost every sports facility is available. We all get medical insurance.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a vibrant life for students and very good career opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. As it is a private college, they collect a good amount of fees to maintain hostels. Wi-Fi is provided to every student with a limit of 10 GB per day. LAN is provided in every room. Classrooms have air conditioners. They are good. The mess is good. The menu keeps changing frequently. Sports facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with placements and teachers, a really good building and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college is very big having a lot of greenery. Wi-Fi is available all the time. There is a library and classrooms as well. There are many facilities like sports, games and medical facilities. Overall, it is a great college. There is a canteen in the campus and the food is really yummy.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus with high vibes, but worthy of it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course, the availability of Wi-Fi and WLAN services, and the maintenance of the library, classroom, and auditorium are up to mark. The management takes a good interest in maintaining them, but coming to the hostel, the only thing that disappoints many students is that there is no AC in the rooms, and the AC in the common rooms is being installed this year itself. All other facilities in the hostel, like drinking water, Wi-Fi, etc., are very good and perfect for students...

reviews.review_heading: BITS Hyderabad is magic.
reviews.review_text: The course is perfect for all students, and it's easy for any type of student to undertake. The campus is fully set up with Wi-Fi routers everywhere, and classrooms are equipped with good Wi-Fi and projectors for students' learning processes. The library is very huge and contains a large number of books. The hostels on the campus are very peaceful and have all the facilities for the students' betterment.

reviews.review_heading: BITS Hyderabad: A campus with good campus life and flexibilities.
reviews.review_text: The complete infrastructure of the college is simply awesome: classrooms, library and auditoriums. Everything is well designed and maintained by the college management, and coming to the hostels, they will be inside the campus itself which is also well maintained by the college management itself and they have all the facilities that a student needs to live.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful curriculum with great placements.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum is perfectly designed and suitable for all students who enjoy studying. Coming to the life and infrastructure, students enjoy a lot in their hostel with their friends and enjoy moving around on campus by playing a lot of games.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and very happy college life and is highly suggested.
reviews.review_text: The accommodation provided on the campus is very good and charges very minimally compared to other institutes. Our course is also designed in a proper way, where there will be quizzes, mid-semester, and final examinations. It's a perfect and good way to complete the course.

reviews.review_heading: BITS Pilani Hyderabad review .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was great to see. In my opinion, this is one of the best engineering colleges where you can find organized infrastructure. It was great to see this. The class has a capacity of nearly 200 with full 24*7 AC. The lab and workshop were also well organized. We also have cricket, football and hockey fields. The mess food is quite decent but not up to par. Hostels are great. From the 2nd year, you have hostels.

reviews.review_heading: About BITS Pilani, in short..
reviews.review_text: Firstly, the infrastructure in our college is very good. We have vast classrooms and a library. Our campus provides wi-fi and broadband connections throughout the campus. Our library is very vast and we have a digital library as well. Our hostel is non AC and we have common washrooms. The food was not so good and not so bad either. We have a lot of games and sports, indoors and outdoors. We have a vast ground.

reviews.review_heading: Plethora of exposure is provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: There are a total of 2 messes,  1 canteen and multiple food stalls on our campus. The mess of food lack variety and many complaints about a lack of hygiene in the preparation of food have been raised in the past. There are many sports and games facilities available in the college, which includes many grounds and an indoor sports complex as well. The lecture halls have good infrastructure and space.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University (BRAOU).
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility in our college. We have a good library and a computer lab. The infrastructure of our college is average.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well maintained. The library is peaceful and has many books. The playground is very good. Labs are good. Our college has around 55 classrooms. The hostel facilities are good. Purified drinking water is provided. Washing machines and television facilities are available. The food in the canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus is beautiful. All facilities are available at the college. We have a separate ground for sports. A canteen is available. The food in the canteen is good. Our classrooms and labs are well-equipped. The hostel facilities are good. Each room has an attached bathroom.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college, faculty members, environment, facilities, fee structure, etc.
reviews.review_text: The college surroundings were excellent, and the environment was natural. Our classrooms were spacious. Wi-Fi was not available throughout the campus. Sports were a great motivation for students. Our lab rooms were good. The library was available at the college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a good environment, well-qualified lecturers, and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good, but I went to the college from my home only. The classrooms are keen and clean. In the university, sports and games are provided for physical health and energy. The library is very helpful to us because we can read books there whenever we are free.

reviews.review_heading: This is a privileged college with less fee as compared to others.
reviews.review_text: It provides good infrastructure. It has a good sports ground. Physical and mental education is also good. Laboratories are fully structured, and the availability of food in the canteen is good. Classrooms are well infrastructure. Digital classrooms are also available. Wi-Fi is available in the laboratories and the classrooms are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: It has good facilities and infrastructure for students. There are also good books in the library, and good equipment in the labs. Good facilities are provided in the hostel premises, and the food served also good for students from the mess as well as from canteen. Games are also conducted in all the courses.

reviews.review_heading: It is best to study in our college to achieve your goals.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available for our course. It is better to study in our college. Most of the intelligent persons in society are from our college. Every student can achieve their goals who are studying in our college. We have an extraordinary peaceful library with high-quality facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college but needs to improve its curriculum, and placements are below average.
reviews.review_text: The weekend classes have good infrastructure like Wi-Fi, computers, and calculators. The library is good. The hostel looks great. I didn't visit the hostel, but some of my friends have been there, so I know about it. The canteen is normal. Sports and games are below average.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, students here do degrees, along with doing some other works.
reviews.review_text: This university doesn't have a hostel facility, mess, canteen, medical facilities and games. There are also no sports in our university. The infrastructure is not bad and not very good here.

reviews.review_heading: The academic structure and books make distance education equal to regular students.
reviews.review_text: This college has a good infrastructure. But due to the distance education programs offered by universities, there are only a few centers across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Among them, only a few centers provide good facilities in academic practical classes and laboratories.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good for placements, and it has well-experienced faculty.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are good. A huge library is available. The hostel is not available in this college because it is not like a regular college, it is an open college for working students. The college has well-experienced teachers.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college but is far away from the main gate. But I am satisfied with college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provided in this college were good but not excellent. Classrooms were the old ones, and the library was average. There was no hostel facility available in our college, as this is an open university. There is no mess available, and a few sports and games were also encouraged.

reviews.review_heading: Review of BRAOU - Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Open University, Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, and the classrooms are much spacious to study. There is no Wi-Fi facility and hostel. However, the campus is nature friendly, and the sports are much encouraged.

reviews.review_heading: It is a place where you get additional degrees by learning on your own.
reviews.review_text: There will be study centres, and I think they are not the asset of this university. Those study centres infrastructure is not much professional, and they look like an unconcerned government school. There is no hostel facility, and all the blocks look like old buildings.

reviews_list.review_title: Great course, great college, and better life .

review_content.Placements: 20 Lacs students write the NEET exam, but only 50 to 60000 students are placed into government medical colleges; hence, it is safe to say that placement percentage for the course is around 1%. There is no particular thing as a package in our course, and after 4 and a half years of studies, we will be given one year of internship, wherein we'll earn around 30000 Rs. monthly.
review_content.Infrastructure: In our college, we have well-equipped laboratories with sophisticated equipments and safety measure. Our lab technician are well educated and help us in our studies. The library facility is quite good; we have thousands of books in our library, and there are well-furnished compartments where students can isolate themselves and study properly. As government college, hostels are also government-funded hostels. We will pay around 800 rupees per month as hostel rent and 4000 approximately per month as mess fees, so overall we will pay around 50000 rupees per annum as mess and hostel accommodation fee. We'll get our own bed, share desk, and cupboard to keep our clothes. Washrooms are attached to the room with geysers and showers in it. Mess food is top-notch and premium quality. In case of medical emergencies, free treatment will be given to the student and gym facility is provided by the hostel to the student where they can enhance their physical attributes. Sports activities are encouraged and annual sports meet is held in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Really good academics and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course was good. The labs were well-equipped with instruments and equipment. The library was well-furnished and had a modern design. The hostel quality of our college was also good, and there were limited sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied with the facilities and placements that were held last year. (2024)
reviews.review_text: Modern, well-maintained classrooms equipped with audiovisual tools and LCD projectors. Both physical and digital libraries feature vast collections of books. reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, good patient flow, and very good in terms of studies and practice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. Huge campus and the best environment. You will love the infrastructure because you'll get amazing pictures. The hospital block has a lift, so it is very convenient. Patients are cooperative as the amount charged is much less for the treatment.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure at DSI are good. The college has well-equipped labs, classrooms with smart boards, and a library with books for all courses. They also have sports facilities and a canteen that serves good food, though it is a bit expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with DSU.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are quite good in our labs and all the machinery works well in the labs. The quality of the hostel is quite good and the food is not upto the mark but comparatively it’s quite a good hostel. The facilities and sports activities are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities and infrastructure. Our college has a cafeteria, and canteen facilities are available. Wi-Fi facilities are very good, and classrooms are maintained neatly. The library has plenty of books, and we can also use the digital library. The hostel facilities are good; they provide hygienic and tasty food with a variety of options daily. The canteen is also available where students can gather in their free time and have a meal. Medical facilities are also good, with...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with this college and it's nice infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of this college are very decent. All the classrooms are fully equipped with high class infrastructure such as Wi-Fi and digital smart rooms. The computer labs are fully equipped with computers and AC. There is great Wi-Fi availability across the department. The Library is filled with information. I haven't been to the hostel but one of my friends stays there, he said everything is worthy including the food and the hostel rooms. In sports, every sport is availabl...

reviews.review_heading: Placements and faculty are good.
reviews.review_text: Our college is equipped with many good facilities, like good labs for practicals and clinics, good infrastructure, and a and a well-stocked library with a huge collection of books. There are many branches. Coming to the hostel facility, the food is very healthy and clean.

reviews.review_heading: My Bachelor’s degree in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Our institution comprises of various courses such as Arts, Polytechnic and Engineering. Each stream is allocated different blocks. 60+ buses are running from our institution. A maximum number of faculty members are working in our college. The food available in our canteen is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: A beautiful campus and a positive environment.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good enough for the students. The classrooms at our college are big in size. Labs have all the required materials, and the library has all kinds of books. The quality of facilities offered at our college hostel is also good, including tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: The best college of my life .
reviews.review_text: The hostel of our college is so good, as the rooms are so comfortable for living, and the rooms are daily cleaned by the hostel staff. If I talk about the mess, the food is so good, the menu changes every week, and we get healthy food.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to study in.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility provided in our college was good with good infrastructure. It provided two sharing rooms. Our college has a canteen that serves only vegetarian food and is maintained hygienically.

reviews.review_heading: I made the best of friends in this college.
reviews.review_text: The university hostel fees is around RS 10,000 whereas the hostel fees for NRI students is Rs 1,50,000. As compared to the price of the hostel, the facilities provided were not up to the mark and the quality of  food was not satisfying. Hostel's basic facilities are decent. Food is the same for both hostel and canteen, where the entire college comes down for lunch, and we have 3 canteens in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is excellent with placements and studies.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a huge space for studying. We have hostels, a library, Wi-Fi, and gaming rooms. It is a student-friendly campus with a lot of facilities. The food is good. They provide medical facilities. We have a lot of other activities except studying.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is best for placements.
reviews.review_text: College has many courses like Engineering, commerce, medicals, mechanical, architecture, etc. and a lot more. There is a separate block of hostels for girls and boys and separate for Indians and NRIs. We have many canteens in every corner of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The fastest growing AIIMS in India.
reviews.review_text: The college has high-quality infrastructure. The college provides Wi-Fi, centralized AC, single room for girls and boys in their final year. The college has a 24/7 library, a gym facility, a ground, indoor game facility, etc. They conduct annual fests. The college has an auditorium, centralized in OPD and IPD. The college has an excellent lecture theatre.

reviews.review_heading: Well-developed tertiary health care center with an amazing infrastructure, academics, and facilities
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available. Great furnished hostel rooms, 24/7 library, air-conditioned classrooms, labs, hospital, and library are available. Food quality is also good. Canteen is available. Lots of sports facilities such as basketball ground, tennis court, TT tables, ground for cricket and other sports available. Campus is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The best thing I have done in my life is choose AIIMS Mangalagiri.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are top-notch. We have free Wi-Fi all over the campus. Hostel room facilities are good, with 2 people per room, but the washrooms are not good. The mess (North Mess) is something I don't like. The canteen is average. Medical facilities are excellent. Sports and games are improving day by day. I think it will be awesome in the upcoming 2 years.

reviews.review_heading: A brief review about AIIMS Mangalagiri.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi in the hostel but available in the classrooms and hospital which are both with central AC facility. The infrastructure is good as it is a new college. The hostel rooms are double-shared but there is no AC facility, food is contact-based and depends on the vendors but is okay.

reviews.review_heading: Better hands-on training than other colleges.
reviews.review_text: Quality of facilities is good. You are provided with a shared room during your UG life and need to shift to a single room in the PG hostel during your internship. 24X7 library facilities are provided with an ample amount of books, online books, and research sources.

reviews.review_heading: Overview of AIIMS Mangalagiri.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well maintained at all times and the college and hospital buildings are AC-ventilated and cleaned on a daily basis. Trees are grown and groomed on the sidewalks which makes the campus look peaceful and pollution-free. Hostel rooms are well maintained but washrooms need to be more taken care of.

reviews.review_heading: A BOON for medical students, Absolutely satisfied with Faculty, Infrastructure, and Opportunities.
reviews.review_text: AIIMS is known for its excellent infrastructure, and AIIMS Mangalagiri is not an exception. The college, library, and hospital are equipped with central air conditioning (AHUs) and have high-speed Wi-Fi, which students can use for academic purposes. Classrooms are equipped with central air conditioning and an advanced set of projectors and mic systems. AIIMS Mangalagiri has excellent faculty who came from different INIs like JIPMER, AIIMS, etc. They are very dedicated and experienced in teaching...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our academics and clinical exposure.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is excellent. The mess food is average and mostly they serve south Indian food. They are planning to establish Wi-Fi in hostels. Hostel have single rooms with bathrooms for girls and double rooms with common bathrooms for boys. The library is fully functional.  Wi-Fi facility is available in college. They provide us with sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best newly established AIIMS.
reviews.review_text:
It has excellent infrastructure with lecture halls, labs, a central library, OPD, and IPD. It is has a central air-conditioning and Wi-Fi.  Hostel infrastructure is also very good, and there are 2 persons per room with all necessary furniture and you can do whatever modification you want. 
Total course fee is around Rs. 6,000 including hostel for whole 5.5 years course. The mess food is fine and charges are around Rs. 4,000 per month. Sports facilities are there with a badminton court, table ten...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good infrastructure and a good environment.
reviews.review_text: As it was a new college and a central college, the infrastructure was good. The hospital was good as it was a private hospital with air conditioning. Recently, IPD and emergency services have started.

reviews.review_text: There are 2 academic blocks, a vaccination center, a main hospital, and hostels. The buildings are good. There is a library. It has all books you need. It also has various journals, which you might need for research purposes. The practical labs are also well-built. The lecture halls have comfortable seats. They are well-ventilated. The main hall is also coolly decorated with paintings.

reviews.review_heading: Review of RUHS College of Medical Sciences.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of this college are good, labs, and lecture theatres are excellent in this college, and classrooms have furnished benches with working air conditioning. Hostel rooms are not so good because there are no attached bathrooms, but each room has a separate balcony, and every month sports matches happen.

reviews.review_heading: All the facilities are absolutely fine and good infrastructure .
reviews.review_text: Labs and lecture theatres are excellent in this college, and classrooms have furnished benches with working air conditioning. Hostel rooms are not so good because there are no bathrooms attached to the rooms, but each room has a separate balcony and multiple grounds available for students for playing.

reviews.review_heading: All the facilities are absolutely fine.
reviews.review_text: Labs and lecture theaters are very good and have excellent working air conditions; hostel rooms are good and attached to bathrooms; large sports fields are common for all the students; and 24-hour medical facilities are available for the students .

reviews.review_heading: Good placements were offered in 2021.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, like the quality of laboratory instruments available, the conditions of hospital rooms are excellent, the staff and food served are excellent in the hostels and the campus is large, which is good compared to other colleges .

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good to study.
reviews.review_text: Buildings are huge with a good environment. All the essentials are near. Laboratory and hospitals are attached to the campus. Hostels are good. Classes are huge with projectors, air-conditioners, and good ventilation.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, good teaching skill of teacher, still developing and evolving.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure wise no doubt, it resembles like private college, it is new building. So infrastructure and equipment are best, and also the hostel is good. Mess is fine and working. Separate washroom and balconies are big relief. Canteen is also fine. Library present, reading room present.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides very good facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have all the facilities in the hostel like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, etc. All the facilities are the best. We have good facilities in the hostel. individual_reviews.title: This university helps every middle class student and gives them the right education.

content.Placements: There are many students placed in various institutes. The highest placement package is 5 LPA and the lowest placement package is 1 LPA. There are many institutional visits yearly, etc. Every student can do an internship as they want and apply where they choose.
content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities available on the campus, and for each department, every classroom has Wi-Fi. There are labs for each department. Classrooms are very big and well-furnished. There are certified and digital libraries and every department has a separate library and the sitting area is good. There are good quality facilities in the hostel. The food quality is like home. There is a hospital also available on campus. There are also many sports grounds like cricket, football, volleyball, badminton and indoor games also available like table tennis, chess and many others.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and the highest package is about 2 crores. There is a good placement ratio.

content.Placements: This university has a great placement ratio of 99.99%. Many companies visit and take placements of students. In my course, Cipla, Sunpharma, and many top companies visit the university. All students have 100% done their internship. In the last year, 26 LPA was the highest package, and the lowest was 8 LPA. This is a very good ratio for all of these courses.
content.Infrastructure: There is strong Wi-Fi connectivity. There are new and highly equipped labs. All classrooms are good. There is a smart board in every class. There is a certified library. The hostel is very clean and hygienic. The food quality is very good, with an FSO-certified mess. There is a hospital. There are many playgrounds for different games, and indoor games are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: There is a very good faculty and better placement than other universities and it is very cheap.

content.Placements: In my college, approximately 60 to 70% of students are placed every year. The highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA to 4 LPA. Every 3rd year, students get a chance to work as interns from our college. In this college, new courses are also offered, and they prepared us for the interview.
content.Infrastructure: There are many classrooms and labs. There is also library in which we study from morning to evening at 8 o'clock. There are very good facilities in our hostel. There are many available sports like volleyball, football, badminton, cricket, chess, kho, kabaddi, and many more. Mess is also very good, and food quality is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am disappointed with their placement promises.

content.Placements: Placements in this college are very bad. In my batch time, only 2 pharma companies from Gujarat came to my college, and they collected resumes only. They did not provide any placements. At the start of the course, the college talked a lot about their placement partner, but at last, no placement companies came to this college.
content.Infrastructure: Actually, the college infrastructure is very good. Hostels are also good, but the food quality is not good. Classrooms are very good. Labs are also good for experiments, and the library is very well-managed. For all departments, a separate library is available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am always thankful to my college, which gives me a better platform for my future.

content.Placements: Every year, about 70-80% of students get placed in the top companies like Cadila, Zydus, Macleods, Helios, and Claroid Cipla. Students get paced with the salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Almost 100% of students got internships after completing their courses. Sometimes in mid-sessions, students get placed in MNC companies.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Technocrats Institute.
reviews.review_text: Technocrats Institute of Technology has a very beautiful infrastructure, and Wi-Fi and smart classes are available in the college. The laboratories are designed very nicely according to AICTE standards. A 1000-seat auditorium is available. Hostel and mess are average.

reviews.review_heading: If you are looking for a private college in Bhopal for placement, then you can join it.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my college is one of the best infrastructures in Bhopal. There is no Wi-Fi for students. Classroom and library are okay. There is also a hostel inside and outside the campus. The food in mess is bad.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with average placement and its tuition feels
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good, with some of them having smart classes. Labs are also good, all the equipment needed is available here. The library is also good, all the books you need for your preparation are available. At the hostel, there are 6-seater rooms and 2-seater rooms with all the basic amenities.

reviews.review_heading: College fees are minimal, every student can afford to have good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college offers well-maintained infrastructure and modern facilities that contribute to a productive learning environment. Classrooms are spacious. The hostel facilities are good and have 24/7 security. The hostel provides basic amenities such as furnished rooms, mess facility, etc.

reviews.review_heading: College life never comes again.
reviews.review_text: My college has a big infrastructure, it has a big building in Bhopal. My college is fully furnished with Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and high-tech library. My college has separate boys' and girls ' campuses. The quality of food is also very good, and the taste of food is also good. Medical and sports facilities are also available. College also provides us with so many tournaments, like cricket and football matches.

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing. It provides the environment for studies as well as growth.
reviews.review_text: Campus of the college is too much attractive. The campus is very wide, large, and beautiful. The campus of the college is around 35 acres of land, and the campus is full of greenery. They provided an environment for studies to the students of the colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent placements and faculty but the strict fine system is the worst part.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good infrastructure with well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, a library, and sports facilities. It also has industry-supported labs by Capgemini and KPIT that help students gain practical knowledge. The campus has two boys' hostels and a girls' hostel nearby. Hostel facilities are decent, though maintenance can sometimes be better. The canteen and mess food is average but manageable, and basic medical facilities are available on campus. Overall, the infrastructure su...

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing in everything.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this college is very good. There are many buildings available in the college. The area and the size of the college are around thirty-five acres. The college is located outside the city, and the average placement of this college is much better compared to other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is world-class, like that of the Indian Institute of Technology. The college is white in colour. The area of the college is spread over 35 acres. The campus is full of greenery.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Bhopal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities available for my course are one of the best among all courses, with 24X7 hours of outstanding Wi-Fi, fully AC classrooms, and a good library. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is decent. The medical facilities are top-notch. There is a huge sports ground where you can play any games.

reviews.review_heading: This college is too good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is next level as compared to other colleges that are available in the college of Bhopal and in Madhya Pradesh. There are too many big and wide campuses of the college that create an encouraging and supportive environment for the students.

reviews.review_heading: It is known for its placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure, including buildings, classrooms, labs, and the library, are all well-arranged with the latest books and equipment. The facilities provided in the hostel are good, and the food quality is not bad for a hostel. Medical facilities are there, but you will not get a career in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: This review contains an honest view of our college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure seems decent, and I don't roam around the campus too much. But overall the infrastructure is good and very well-maintained. The hostel facilities are not for boys and girls, so we have to rent a PG. Campus is full of Wi-Fi and air-conditioned classes also in some rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Better option in Bhopal for placements.
reviews.review_text: College campus is very beautiful with lush green gardens and well-maintained buildings and classrooms. In the library, every book is available, and AC is there. Labs are decent, but some equipment are not updated to the new version. Hostel facilities are good, and the quality of food is decent with a variety of options for snacks.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with lower fees.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are the facilities available in my department. There's not a single problem with them, as far as the library is concerned, except when you have to, when there are classes scheduled. Otherwise, you can't randomly go out there and do whatever you want to do. All the things, such as sports, games, medical facilities, canteen, and mess, are also good. There's no problem with related stuff.

(Dairy Technology) program, the mode of admission is through counseling of the eligible candidates from the merit list of WBUAFS/WBJEEB ranks (wherever applicable).For the M.Tech. and other postgraduate programs, the university conducts written test examinations and personal interviews for final selection
faqs.question: Q: Which entrance exam scores are accepted by West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences for admission?

faqs.answer: Yes, the West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences accepts the WBJEE score for admission to its BTech courses. The admission criteria for Bachelor of Fishery Sciences (B.F.Sc) include qualifying in the West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination for Engineering/Technology (WBJEE) conducted by WBJEEB, passing Higher Secondary (10+2) Examination of the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education or its equivalent examination in Science stream from any recognised Board/Council from any institution, and being a citizen of India, not less than 17 years as on 31st December in the year of application, and a domicile of West Bengal.

Admission to most of the undergraduate courses is done on the basis of the WBJEE entrance examination, while eligibility for postgraduate and Ph.D. courses requires graduation and postgraduation in a relevant field.

The university has been recognised as one of the leading institutions in the country to uplift the socio-economical status of farmers and has been engaged in improving research infrastructure to develop cutting-edge technologies for improved management of animal and fishery resources, disease problems, nutrients, water resources, and the environment. The university has three faculties, namely Faculty of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, Faculty of Dairy Technology, and Faculty of Fishery Sciences. Therefore, West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences can be considered a good option for pursuing M.Tech in Dairy Technology and Fishery Sciences.

faqs.question: Does West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences accept JEE score?
faqs.answer: Yes, the West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences accepts the WBJEE score for admission to its BTech courses. The admission criteria for Bachelor of Fishery Sciences (B.F.Sc) include qualifying in the West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination for Engineering/Technology (WBJEE) conducted by WBJEEB, passing Higher Secondary (10+2) Examination of the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education or its equivalent examination in Science stream from any recognised Board/Council from any institution, and being a citizen of India, not less than 17 years as on 31st December in the year of application, and a domicile of West Bengal.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for B.Tech at West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences?
faqs.answer: The seat intake for the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programme at the West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences (WBUAFS) is 44 seats. The reservations of seats for this programme are as follows:SC-22%, ST-6%, OBC-A-10%, OBC-B-7%, ICAR Nominee-15%, Person with Disability (PwD)-5%*GTA- 01* seat in each course.GTA & PwD seat @ 5% (i.e., 02) will be on a horizontal basis.The selected candidates will be placed in the appropriate category, i.e., General, SC, ST, OBC-A, and OBC-B, to which they belong.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam scores are accepted by West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences for admission?
faqs.answer: The West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences (WBUAFS) accepts the following entrance exam scores for admission to different programs:For the B.V.Sc. & A.H. program, the candidate must qualify and obtain a rank in the NEET-UG conducted by NTA.For the B.F.Sc. program, the selection of students for admission will be done as per a merit list without any entrance examination. The merit list will be prepared according to the percentage of total marks obtained in the subjects of H.S. or its equivalent examinations.For the B.Tech. (Dairy Technology) program, the mode of admission is through counseling of the eligible candidates from the merit list of WBUAFS/WBJEEB ranks (wherever applicable).For the M.Tech. and other postgraduate programs, the university conducts written test examinations and personal interviews for final selection

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for M.Tech at West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for M.Tech at West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences requires the candidate to have a minimum of 6.2 Overall Grade Point Average (O.G.P.A.) for general category & 6.0 for SC, ST, OBC-A & OBC-B, PwD categories in 10 point scale in their B.V.Sc. & A.H., B.Tech. (D.T.) & B.F.Sc. courses.

paragraphs: As per the NIRF report 2024 released by UPUMS, the median package offered during UG 4-year and UG 5-year placements 2023 stood at INR 1.92 LPA and INR 2.4 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package offered during PG 3-year placements 2023 stood at INR 14.75 LPA . Earlier, NIRF report 2023 is available on the official website. faqs.question: How are MBBS placements at Uttar Pradesh University of Medical Sciences?

Some of the popular job profiles for BPharm candidates are TSPSC Drug Inspector, MPSC Pharmacist, ESIC Pharmacist, SBI Pharmacist, etc.
